_nota: Prompts para ElevenLabs Sound Effects (en inglés: el modelo responde mejor). duration en segundos (0.5–30); influence 0–1 (más alto = más literal). 'uso' = animación o evento del juego.

sonidos.text: Two steel longswords clashing hard, sharp metallic impact with bright ringing resonance and short shimmering tail, close-mic, dry, game sound effect
Heavy two-handed greatsword slamming into another blade, deep metallic clang with low-end thud, grinding scrape, long ringing decay, epic fantasy combat
Two swords locked together, steel blades scraping and grinding along each other under pressure, tense metallic screech, ends with a sharp release
Perfect sword parry, crisp high-pitched steel ting with sparks crackling, quick bright whoosh, satisfying and punchy, video game
Sword striking a reinforced wooden and iron shield, heavy wooden thump layered with metal clank, short rattle
Fast sword swing whoosh cutting through air, sharp airy swish, no impact

sonidos.uso: golpe que acierta a un enemigo
sonidos.text: Sword slash hitting armored flesh, wet cut layered with chainmail rattle and dull impact, short and punchy, fantasy combat
Warrior spinning with a blade, two rapid whooshing circular sword swings with rising wind swirl, ending in a metallic ring
Lightning bolt striking the ground at close range, violent electric crack followed by deep booming thunder and sizzling electrical crackle, cinematic

sonidos.uso: inicio de triple_corkscrew / carga de hechizo
sonidos.text: Magical electricity charging up, rising high-voltage hum with crackling arcs and buzzing static building in intensity, ends abruptly
Chain lightning spell, fast zapping electric arcs jumping between targets, three quick snapping zaps with buzzing tails
Electrified sword swing, blade whoosh layered with crackling electricity and sharp static zap at the end
Distant rolling thunder rumbling across a valley, low and long, no rain
Arcane nova explosion, magical energy bursting outward in a ring, deep whoomp with shimmering crystalline sparkle and airy shockwave tail
Massive ground slam, earth shattering with heavy rock crunch, low sub-bass boom and debris crumbling afterwards
Wizard casting a magic missile from a staff, whooshing energy projectile with glowing hum and sparkling trail
Dragon breathing a stream of fire, roaring flamethrower whoosh with crackling flames and low growl underneath
Freezing frost breath spell, icy wind blast with crystalline crackling as ice forms and shatters
Holy healing spell, warm rising chime shimmer with soft choir-like pad, gentle and bright
